source_excerpt:
The SJSGC fellowship is administered by the University Grants Commission (UGC).
It supports eligible single girl children pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. in India.
The current UGC webpage lists monthly fellowship rates of ₹37,000 for the first two years and ₹42,000 thereafter.
Eligible scholars may also receive annual contingency grants and other applicable assistance.
University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of Education, Government of India Phone: 011-23604446, 011-23604200 Email: [email protected]
Higher education and research can open doors to new opportunities, but pursuing a Ph.D. also requires time, dedication, and financial support. To support eligible single girl children in continuing their doctoral studies, the Government of India introduced the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) . This fellowship provides financial assistance to eligible candidates pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. in recognised Indian institutions. Under the current rates listed on the official UGC scheme page, selected scholars receive ₹37,000 per month during the first two years as Junior Research Fellows (JRF) and ₹42,000 per month during the remaining tenure as Senior Research Fellows (SRF), subject to the applicable conditions. The scheme also provides annual contingency grants for research-related expenses and other applicable assistance.
The fellowship is administered by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its objectives include promoting higher education among single girl children, recognising the importance of the small-family norm, and encouraging the social recognition of single girl children. Although the scheme's objectives refer to Social Sciences, eligible candidates can pursue Ph.D. research in any stream or subject, provided they meet the prescribed conditions.
To apply for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship, a candidate must generally be the only girl child i n her family, without a brother or sister. Twin or fraternal daughters are also eligible under the specified rules. The applicant must be pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. and meet the prescribed age limit, which is generally up to 40 years for the General category and up to 45 years for the specified reserved categories and Persons with Disabilities (PwD). Part-time, distance-mode and open-mode Ph.D. programmes are not covered. Applicants must also provide the prescribed single-girl-child affidavit and satisfy the applicable institutional and documentary requirements.
The fellowship can continue for up to five years or until the Ph.D. thesis is submitted, whichever occurs earlier. Applications are submitted online through the UGC Fellowship and Research Grant portal when applications are invited. Prospective applicants should check the UGC website and the fellowship portal for the latest notification before preparing their applications.
For assistance, applicants can contact the University Grants Commission through its official contact page . The UGC's published contact details include telephone numbers 011-23604446 and 011-23604200, and the email address [email protected] . For scheme-specific questions, applicants should also check the instructions and contact information available on the fellowship portal.
Students exploring other education-support opportunities can also read about the Indira Gandhi Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child , which supports eligible single girl children pursuing postgraduate studies, and the Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship , which provides financial assistance to eligible college and university students. These schemes have different eligibility conditions and benefits, so students should check their respective guidelines before applying.
The Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) provides financial support to eligible single girl children pursuing a full-time Ph.D. in India. The main benefits of this fellowship include:
Selected scholars receive ₹37,000 per month for the first two years of their Ph.D. as Junior Research Fellows (JRF).
After the first two years, the monthly fellowship increases to ₹42,000 for the remaining eligible tenure as Senior Research Fellows (SRF), subject to satisfactory research progress and applicable rules.
Humanities and Social Sciences scholars receive a contingency grant of ₹10,000 per year during the first two years and ₹20,500 per year thereafter.
Science, Engineering and Technology scholars receive a contingency grant of ₹12,000 per year during the first two years and ₹25,000 per year thereafter.
Eligible scholars with disabilities can receive ₹3,000 per month for escort or reader assistance, as applicable under the scheme rules.
House Rent Allowance (HRA) may be provided according to the applicable Government of India rules and the scholar's accommodation arrangements.
The fellowship can continue for up to five years or until the Ph.D. thesis is submitted, whichever occurs earlier, subject to the scheme's conditions.
The fellowship helps scholars manage their living expenses and research-related costs while working towards their doctoral degree.
Fellowship Amount and Financial Assistance
The Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child provides monthly financial support to eligible Ph.D. scholars, along with an annual grant to help cover research-related expenses. The amount depends on the stage of the fellowship and the scholar's field of study.
₹37,000 per month for the first two years
₹42,000 per month for the remaining period, subject to applicable conditions

₹10,000 per year for the first two years and ₹20,500 per year for the remaining period

The contingency grant helps scholars meet eligible research expenses. It is paid annually, not monthly. The fellowship can continue for up to five years or until the Ph.D. thesis is submitted, whichever occurs earlier, subject to the scheme rules.
Important: The current UGC scheme webpage lists the monthly fellowship rates shown above. However, the detailed guidelines PDF available on the UGC fellowship portal lists earlier JRF and SRF rates of ₹31,000 and ₹35,000 per month. Applicants should check the latest applicable notification and award terms to confirm the rates for their selection cycle.
Before applying for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC), applicants should check whether they meet the scheme's eligibility conditions. The main requirements are as follows:
The applicant must be a single girl child of her parents, with no brother or sister. Twin or fraternal daughters are also eligible under the applicable rules.
The applicant must be pursuing a Ph.D. in any subject or stream at a recognised university, college or institution in India.
The Ph.D. programme must be regular and full-time. Part-time, distance-learning and open-mode Ph.D. programmes are not eligible.
The applicant must generally be up to 40 years of age. The age limit is relaxed up to 45 years for SC/ST/OBC and Persons with Disabilities (PwD), as specified in the scheme guidelines. Age is considered on the last date of application.
The applicant must submit the prescribed affidavit declaring that she is the only girl child in the family. It must be prepared on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper and attested by an authorised officer as specified in the guidelines.
The applicant must meet the documentation and verification requirements prescribed by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and her institution.
Fellowship slots are decided each year based on the eligible online applications received in complete form. Meeting the eligibility conditions does not automatically guarantee selection.
Applicants should read the official UGC scheme guidelines carefully and check the latest application notification for any updated conditions before applying.
Applicants should keep the required documents ready before filling out the online application for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC). The documents help verify the applicant's eligibility and Ph.D. details. These may include:
A recent passport-size photograph and scanned signature in the prescribed format.
An affidavit on ₹100 stamp paper confirming that the applicant is the only girl child in the family, prepared in the format given in the UGC guidelines and attested by an SDM, First Class Magistrate or Tehsildar. If the parents are no longer alive, the guardian may submit the affidavit as permitted under the guidelines.
Details and supporting documents related to the applicant's postgraduate education.
Ph.D. registration and admission details from the recognised university, college or institution.
A research proposal and its abstract, if required in the application portal.
The application form generated through the portal, signed by the Head of Department (HoD) or Registrar, if required by the current application instructions.
If you meet the eligibility conditions for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC), the next step is to complete the online application carefully. Applications are accepted through the UGC Fellowship and Research Grant portal when the scheme is open for applications. Follow these steps to fill out the form.
Open the UGC Fellowship and Research Grant Portal and look for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child. If applications are open, select the registration option, such as "New User", and enter the details requested. Keep your email address, scanned photograph and signature ready in the format specified on the portal.
After registering, check your email for the login details or instructions provided by the portal. Log in to your account and change your password if prompted.
Open your dashboard and review your personal details. Find the "Eligibility Criteria" section, read the conditions carefully and check that you meet the requirements before continuing.
Complete the eligibility section and upload the required affidavit confirming that you are a single girl child. Make sure the affidavit follows the format and attestation rules given in the UGC guidelines. Check the information carefully before moving to the next step.
Fill in your postgraduate education details and provide the requested information about your Ph.D. registration and research. Upload your research proposal, abstract and any other documents required by the application form.
Read the declaration carefully and check that all the information you have entered is correct. Submit the application according to the portal's instructions. If a signed form from your Head of Department (HoD) or Registrar is required, complete that step as directed.
Before finishing, make sure all mandatory sections are complete and your uploaded documents are clear and readable. Download or save a copy of the submitted application and keep it for future reference.
Registration steps and document requirements may change between application cycles. Follow the instructions displayed on the portal and in the latest UGC notification. If applications are not currently open, check the portal again when a new notification is issued.
Important: Please note that completing the application does not guarantee selection. The UGC decides the number of fellowship slots based on eligible applications received in complete form. Applications should be submitted only during the notified application period. Check the UGC's official scheme page for scheme information and the fellowship portal for application availability and current instructions.

1. What is the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child?
The Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is a UGC fellowship that provides financial assistance to eligible single girl children pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. in India.
2. Who is eligible for the SJSGC fellowship?
A girl who is the only child of her parents, with no brother or sister, may be eligible if she is pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. at a recognised Indian institution and meets the other scheme conditions. Twin or fraternal daughters are also eligible under the prescribed rules.
3. What is the age limit for the SJSGC fellowship?
The general age limit is up to 40 years. It is relaxed up to 45 years for SC, ST, OBC and Persons with Disabilities (PwD), as specified in the scheme guidelines. Applicants should check the latest notification for the applicable conditions.
4. How much financial assistance is provided under this fellowship?
The current UGC scheme webpage lists ₹37,000 per month for the first two years and ₹42,000 per month for the remaining tenure, subject to applicable conditions. Applicants should confirm the rates in the latest notification because the detailed guidelines may show older amounts.
5. Is the fellowship available for all Ph.D. subjects?
Yes. Eligible candidates can pursue a Ph.D. in any subject or stream at a recognised Indian institution, provided they meet the scheme requirements.
6. Can students pursuing a part-time or distance Ph.D. apply?
No. The scheme is intended for eligible scholars pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. Part-time, distance-mode and open-mode Ph.D. programmes are not covered under the stated eligibility conditions.
7. What is the duration of the SJSGC fellowship?
The fellowship can continue for up to five years or until the Ph.D. thesis is submitted, whichever occurs earlier, subject to the applicable rules.
8. Which documents are required to apply for the fellowship?
Applicants may need a single-girl-child affidavit in the prescribed format, educational certificates, Ph.D. registration details, a photograph, a signature and other documents requested by the application portal. Check the latest guidelines for the exact requirements.
9. How can I apply for the Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship?
Applications are submitted online through the UGC Fellowship and Research Grant portal when applications are invited. Applicants should read the guidelines, complete the registration, fill in the required details and upload the prescribed documents.
10. Are applications for the SJSGC fellowship currently open?
Application availability depends on UGC notifications. Check the official UGC scheme page and the fellowship portal for the latest application announcement before applying.

सावित्रीबाई ज्योतिराव फुले फेलोशिप फॉर सिंगल गर्ल चाइल्ड (SJSGC) भारत सरकार के शिक्षा मंत्रालय के तहत विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) द्वारा प्रशासित एक पहल है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य पात्र एकल बालिकाओं को मान्यता प्राप्त भारतीय संस्थानों में नियमित, पूर्णकालिक पीएचडी करने के लिए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना है।

## मुख्य विवरण और उद्देश्य

इस फेलोशिप का मुख्य उद्देश्य एकल बालिकाओं में उच्च शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देना, छोटे परिवार के मानदंडों के महत्व को पहचानना और सामाजिक मान्यता को प्रोत्साहित करना है। पात्र उम्मीदवार निर्धारित शर्तों को पूरा करने पर किसी भी स्ट्रीम या विषय में अपनी शोध पढ़ाई कर सकते हैं।

## वित्तीय सहायता और दरें

चयनित शोधकर्ताओं को आजीविका और अनुसंधान खर्चों को प्रबंधित करने के लिए मासिक वजीफा और वार्षिक आकस्मिक अनुदान मिलता है। आधिकारिक यूजीसी योजना पृष्ठ पर सूचीबद्ध वर्तमान वित्तीय प्रावधानों में शामिल हैं:

* **जूनियर रिसर्च फेलोशिप (JRF):** पहले दो वर्षों के लिए ₹37,000 प्रति माह।
* **सीनियर रिसर्च फेलोशिप (SRF):** संतोषजनक प्रगति के अधीन शेष कार्यकाल के लिए ₹42,000 प्रति माह।
* **आकस्मिक अनुदान (Contingency Grants):** अध्ययन के क्षेत्र के आधार पर अनुसंधान खर्चों के लिए अलग-अलग वार्षिक राशि।
* **अतिरिक्त सहायता:** पात्र विकलांग विद्वानों के लिए भत्ते और लागू सरकारी नियमों के अनुसार मकान किराया भत्ता (HRA)।

*नोट: चूंकि विस्तृत दिशानिर्देश दस्तावेज पुरानी दरों को भी दर्शा सकते हैं, इसलिए आवेदकों को नवीनतम आधिकारिक अधिसूचनाओं से दरों की पुष्टि करनी चाहिए।* फेलोशिप की अवधि अधिकतम पांच साल या थीसिस जमा होने तक (जो भी पहले हो) होती है।

## पात्रता मानदंड

विचार किए जाने के लिए उम्मीदवारों को आम तौर पर निम्नलिखित शर्तों को पूरा करना होगा:

* आवेदक अपने माता-पिता की इकलौती लड़की होनी चाहिए, जिसका कोई भाई या बहन न हो (विशिष्ट नियमों के तहत जुड़वां बेटियां भी पात्र हैं)।
* भारत में किसी मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थान में नियमित, पूर्णकालिक पीएचडी कार्यक्रम में नामांकित होना अनिवार्य है। अंशकालिक और दूरस्थ शिक्षा कार्यक्रम पात्र नहीं हैं।
* सामान्य श्रेणी के लिए आयु सीमा आम तौर पर 40 वर्ष तक है, जबकि एससी, एसटी, ओबीसी और दिव्यांग (PwD) उम्मीदवारों के लिए इसे 45 वर्ष तक की छूट दी गई है।
* गैर-न्यायिक स्टाम्प पेपर पर एक निर्धारित शपथ पत्र (affidavit) प्रस्तुत करना आवश्यक है।

## आवेदन कैसे करें और सत्यापन

आवेदन केवल सक्रिय चक्रों के दौरान आधिकारिक यूजीसी फेलोशिप और रिसर्च ग्रांट पोर्टल के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन जमा किए जाते हैं। संभावित आवेदकों को पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण करना होगा, विवरण भरना होगा, और स्कैन किए गए दस्तावेज जैसे फोटो, हस्ताक्षर और शपथ पत्र अपलोड करने होंगे।

पात्रता मानदंडों को पूरा करने से चयन की गारंटी स्वतः नहीं मिलती है। इच्छुक उम्मीदवारों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे आवेदन करने से पहले नवीनतम समय-सीमा और दिशा-निर्देशों के लिए यूजीसी की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट की जांच करें।

en_body:
The Savitribai Jyotirao Phule Fellowship for Single Girl Child (SJSGC) is an initiative administered by the University Grants Commission (UGC) under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Designed to promote higher education and support doctoral studies, the scheme provides financial assistance to eligible single girl children pursuing a regular, full-time Ph.D. in recognized Indian institutions.

## Overview and Objectives

The primary objective of the fellowship is to encourage higher education among single girl children, recognize the importance of the small-family norm, and foster social recognition. Although the initial framework references Social Sciences, eligible candidates can pursue Ph.D. research across any stream or subject, provided they satisfy all prescribed requirements.

## Financial Assistance and Rates

Selected scholars receive monthly stipends and annual contingency grants to assist with living expenses and research costs. The current financial provisions reported on the official UGC scheme pages include:

* **Junior Research Fellowship (JRF):** ₹37,000 per month for the first two years.
* **Senior Research Fellowship (SRF):** ₹42,000 per month for the remaining tenure, subject to satisfactory progress and scheme rules.
* **Contingency Grants:** Varying annual amounts provided for research expenses depending on the field of study (e.g., Humanities, Social Sciences, Science, Engineering, and Technology).
* **Additional Support:** Disability allowances for eligible scholars and House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per applicable government guidelines.

*Note: Applicants should verify rates across official notifications, as detailed guideline documents may reflect older figures.* The duration of the fellowship lasts for up to five years or until thesis submission, whichever happens first.

## Eligibility Requirements

To qualify for consideration, candidates must generally meet the following criteria:

* Must be the only girl child of her parents, without a brother or sister (twin or fraternal daughters are also considered under specific rules).
* Enrolled in a regular, full-time Ph.D. program in India. Part-time, distance, and open-mode programs are excluded.
* Age limit is generally up to 40 years for General category applicants, with relaxation up to 45 years for SC, ST, OBC, and Persons with Disabilities (PwD).
* Must provide a prescribed single-girl-child affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, attested by an authorized officer.

## How to Apply and Verification

Applications are processed online through the official UGC Fellowship and Research Grant portal exclusively during active application cycles. Prospective applicants must complete user registration, fill out the dashboard details, upload scanned documents (such as photographs, signatures, and the mandatory affidavit), and submit the form along with institutional documentation.

Meeting the baseline eligibility criteria does not guarantee selection, as fellowship slots depend on the volume of complete online applications received. Interested candidates should consult the official UGC website and active portal notices to verify current deadlines, guidelines, and contact channels before applying.
